hebrewText: לָבְשׁ֬וּ כָרִ֨ים הַ/צֹּ֗אן וַ/עֲמָקִ֥ים יַֽעַטְפוּ בָ֑ר יִ֝תְרוֹעֲע֗וּ אַף יָשִֽׁירוּ

tokens.bdb: properly, wrap around, i.e. (by implication) to put on agarment or clothe (oneself, or another), literally or figuratively
tokens.kjv: (in) apparel, arm, array (self), clothe (self), come upon, put (on, upon), wear.

tokens.bdb: a ram (as full-grown and fat), including a battering-ram (as butting); hence, a meadow (as for sheep); also a pad or camel's saddle (as puffed out)
tokens.kjv: captain, furniture, lamb, (large) pasture, ram. See also H1033 (בֵּית כַּר), H3746 (כָּרִי).

tokens.bdb: a collective name for a flock (of sheep or goats); also figuratively (of men)
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a collective name for a flock ; also figuratively
tokens.enLiteralWord: a collective name for a flock ; also figuratively
tokens.explanation: a collective name for a flock ; also figuratively
tokens.explanationEn: a collective name for a flock ; also figuratively

tokens.kjv: dale, vale, valley (often used as a part of proper names). See also H1025 (בֵּית הָעֵמֶק).

tokens.bdb: to shroud, i.e. clothe (whether transitive or reflex.); hence (from the idea of darkness) to languish
tokens.kjv: cover (over), fail, faint, feebler, hide self, be overwhelmed, swoon.

tokens.bdb: grain of any kind (even while standing in the field); by extension the open country
tokens.ptLiteralWord: grain of any kind ; by extension the open country
tokens.enLiteralWord: grain of any kind ; by extension the open country
tokens.explanation: grain of any kind ; by extension the open country
tokens.explanationEn: grain of any kind ; by extension the open country

tokens.bdb: to mar (especially by breaking); figuratively, to split the ears (with sound), i.e. shout (for alarm or joy)
tokens.kjv: blow an alarm, cry (alarm, aloud, out), destroy, make a joyful noise, smart, shout (for joy), sound an alarm, triumph.

tokens.bdb: meaning accession (used as an adverb or conjunction); also or yea; adversatively though
tokens.kjv: also, [phrase] although, and (furthermore, yet), but, even, [phrase] how much less (more, rather than), moreover, with, yea.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: meaning accession ; also or yea; adversatively though
tokens.enLiteralWord: meaning accession ; also or yea; adversatively though
tokens.explanation: meaning accession ; also or yea; adversatively though
tokens.explanationEn: meaning accession ; also or yea; adversatively though

tokens.kjv: behold (by mistake for H7789 (שׁוּר)), sing(-er, -ing man, -ing woman).
